# Jobpac Connect API (Trimble Jobpac construction ERP)

- **Product:** Jobpac Connect API (Trimble Jobpac construction ERP) (Construction software family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** a session token from GiveMeAToken (user ID and password AES-encrypted with a key Trimble issues per environment and application), passed in the Token query parameter. Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** Jobpac customers and partners issued an encryption key by Trimble.
- **To call it you would need:** a Jobpac token for the customer's jwis*.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001 host; operations that take the token in the request, and the token operations themselves, are excluded as credential operations.
- **Documented servers:** `https://jwis.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001`, `https://jwis3.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001`, `https://jwis5.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001`, `https://jwis7.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001`, `https://jwis9.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001`, `https://jwis.staging.cloud.jobpac.com.au:9001`.
- **Definition:** [jobpac-connect](https://api-doc.jobpac.com.au/) (Jobpac Connect API, version 1.0.0). Documentation: https://help.trimble.com/doc/jobpac-connect/jobpac-connect/connect-with-jobpac-apis/connect-with-jobpac-apis.
